name: dp-sk-metodika-grab
description: Downloads Slovak guidance PDFs into <dir>: Financna sprava section listings and the MF SR, NBS and UVO pdf sites. Writes sidecar files and _coverage.json for the convert class.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item fetch its listing and write the PDFs, a sidecar per document and _coverage.json into <dir>/<itemId>. Restart-safe. UVO needs uvoRobotsAck. dryRun: no request.

items.description: the items to download, as reported by the detect step

only.description: sample filter: [{section|site, docId}] with docId = source_id

maxDocs.description: sample filter: documents per item, ascending source_id

maxPdfBytes.description: skip a PDF larger than this (default 40 MB)

baseUrl.description: replay server origin that stands in for all four sites

uvoRobotsAck.description: must be true to grab uvo-metodicke (robots.txt of uvo.gov.sk disallows crawlers, decision D141)

dryRun.description: plan only: no request, nothing written
